stem: The harvest work order was valid at startup, but a spill later creates an uncontrolled slip hazard. What controls the next action?
choices: The original authorization means work must continue
Only the supervisor may notice a hazard
Reassess the changed condition and apply authorized control or stop/escalate before continuing
rationale: Reassess the changed condition and apply authorized control or stop/escalate before continuing. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
